Data.text:
Healing Agent (Autopilot for Robots) is tied to **processes executed as jobs**, not to ad‑hoc debug/run sessions from Studio.

From the FAQ:  
> “Healing Agent is currently only available for **processes executed as jobs**. Healing Agent is **not available for other types of jobs, such as triggers or test cases**.”  

The docs do not mention Healing Agent running during Studio debug/run, nor producing healing-fixes.json or UIA telemetry in that context. All described flows (including downloading the debug file from Orchestrator and analyzing it in Studio via Autopilot) assume:

- The automation was **published and executed as a job in Orchestrator**.
- Healing Agent was **enabled at the process level**.
- Healing actions/recommendations occurred during that job run.

So, based on the available documentation:

- **Yes**, Healing Agent produces recovery data (debug file with healing info) for **eligible Orchestrator jobs**.
- **No documented support** for generating that data when you just run or debug directly from Studio/StudioPro in attended mode without going through an Orchestrator job.
